issue comment so product and sales can assess priority in one place.

attributes.mcp.request.argument.body:
Summary:
Customer has requested the ability to export reports as Excel files (in addition to the existing PDF export). This is the third export-related request from the same customer this quarter; estimated impact: medium — affects reporting workflow specifically.

Context:
- Related workspace context for repeat asks lives on the Notion page “Customer Revenue Dashboard” (product and sales often reference one or two customer-revenue entries to assess priority).

Suggested next steps / questions:
1) Clarify exact scope: which report(s) should support Excel export (all reports vs specific ones), and whether they need .xlsx or .xls compatibility.
2) Ask the customer (or sales rep) for example reports/fields they expect exported and any formatting requirements (pivot tables, column ordering, date/time formats, locale/number formatting).
3) Discuss acceptable minimal delivery for an MVP (e.g., tabular .xlsx export of report rows, no advanced formatting or formulas).
4) Estimate and owner: assign a product owner and ask engineering for an estimate (effort, data privacy considerations, performance for large exports).
5) Acceptance criteria examples:
   - Export button available on targeted report pages
   - Downloaded .xlsx contains the same rows/columns/filters as the PDF/export view
   - Handles paging/large row counts (or documents limits clearly)
   - Basic formatting (headers, data types) and correct locale formatting

Notes for prioritization:
- Because this is a repeat request from the same customer this quarter, consider including a short account snapshot (revenue / contract) from the Notion “Customer Revenue Dashboard” to help prioritize.

If helpful, I can: 1) add a checklist to this issue with the clarifying questions, 2) link the Notion page or paste the relevant customer-revenue snippet (if you grant access), or 3) create a lightweight implementation proposal (options: server-side generation with a library like OpenXML/SheetJS vs client-side CSV/XLSX).

Please advise which next step you want me to take.
